Hybrid Infrastructure Support: Administer and support core on-premises Windows infrastructure (Windows Server 2016–2022, Hyper-V, IIS) alongside key vendor platforms (Microsoft, Fortinet, Commvault).

Azure Landing Zones & Governance: Demonstrated track record implementing solutions from architectural artefacts, covering Landing Zones, hub-and-spoke networking, identity and access, security, resilience, and hybrid connectivity, alongside active participation in design reviews and technical docume
Identity & Hybrid Administration: Advanced administration skills across Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Hyper-V, plus familiarity with Windows Server (2016–2022), IIS, Fortinet, and Commvault.
